title: IPv4 hostname regex matches invalid dotted numbers, producing false positives in the exposure report

finding.claim: IPv4 hostname regex matches invalid dotted numbers, producing false positives in the exposure report
finding.recommendation: Tighten the IPv4 pattern to valid octets, or post-validate matches before counting them as hostnames. Otherwise arbitrary version-like or numeric strings can be reported as exposed hostnames.

code_region.text:
os.makedirs(RESULTS, exist_ok=True)

PATTERNS = {
    "local_path": re.compile(
        r"(?:/home/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+|/root|/opt/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+"
        r"|~/workspace)[^\s\"'<>]*"),
    "hostname": re.compile(
        r"\b(?:[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.(?:loca\.lt|local|internal|lan)\b"
        r"|\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\b"
        r"|[A-Za-z0-9-]*-prod\b)"),
    "connector_name": re.compile(
        r"\b(?:custom\.[a-z0-9-]+|gmail|google_calendar|"
        r"google_drive|google_docs|stripe|meta_ads|threads|"
        r"instagram|facebook_cli|messenger_read|onepassword|"
        r"shop-pay|shopify|spotify|duffel|flightaware|"
        r"ticketmaster|plaid|tailscale)\b"),
    "account_id": re.compile(
        r"\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b"),
    "key_shaped": re.compile(
        r"(?:sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}"
        r"|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}"

refutation.reason: No panel refutation was recorded for this finding — it reached the workup undisputed. The opposing/confirmatory position is the executed probe in SS3 of the packet: Secret-scan probe (`probes/closing_records_scan_probe.py`, section a): the IPv4-shape pattern at the centre of this finding was executed against candidate strings. It MATCHES '999.123.456.789', '256.1.1.1', and '300.300.300.300' — none of which are valid IPv4 addresses — alongside true positives ('10.0.0.1', '192.168.001.001'). The pattern validates shape only; octet range is unchecked. Consequence bounded: a false positive here over-redacts/reports a secret-shaped string in scan output — over-inclusive, never under-inclusive.
